title: Terminal input discard follow-ups from the WCLI-97 review (silent failures, wraps, cap test)
description: Not a flip gate. Non-blocking items of the round-3 Opus review of opum-ai/ward-cli#236 (merged 8619d91): LOW 5, a throwing tcflush or poll, or a persistent negative poll result, is still silent, so optionally warn once after N consecutive failures; NITs 6 and 7, rewrap src/adapters/passphrase.ts around line 16 and the header of test/pty-residue.test.ts around line 7; tighten the cap test in test/terminal-input.test.ts so a loop that never goes quiet must make more than 1000 polls rather than any.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A throwing flush or poll, or a persistent negative poll, produces one stderr notice
The two comment wraps are fixed
The cap test asserts the drain polls more than 1000 times before it is released
